name: rk-design-tokens
description: Design tokens for the Røde Kors design system.

scripts.build:tokens: designsystemet tokens build --config designsystemet.config.json --out-dir design-tokens-build/digdir && cp styles/theme.css styles/konferansesenter.css styles/figma.css design-tokens-build/ && cp design-tokens-build/digdir/*.d.ts design-tokens-build/
scripts.build:dist: cp designsystemet.config.json design-tokens-build/designsystemet.config.json && cp design-tokens-build/theme.css dist/brand-1.css && cp -R design-tokens-build/digdir dist/ && cp design-tokens-build/figma.css design-tokens-build/shadcn-theme.css design-tokens-build/types.d.ts design-tokens-build/colors.d.ts dist/
scripts.build: npm run build:tokens && npm run build:bootstrap && npm run build:shadcn && npm run build:metadata && npm run build:dist
